title: Domain
description: Core game vocabulary shared by every package. Adding a value is a reviewed contract change; removing or renaming one is a breaking change.

GamePhase.description: Where a live game is in its state machine. Only game/ moves a game between phases.

AnswerSource.description: How an answer was given: spoken (every clue and Daily Double) or typed (Final Schmegettes only). Mirrors public.answer_source.

TimerPace.description: The game's pace, chosen in the lobby: how long buzzing stays open and how long a player has to answer. relaxed 15 s / 12 s, standard 9 s / 9 s, fast 5 s / 7 s. Mirrors public.timer_pace.

MatchRule.description: Which judging rule decided an answer. Mirrors public.match_rule.

PlayerRole.description: host runs the board and can override verdicts; contestants buzz and answer; spectators watch.

Difficulty.description: A clue category's difficulty, and the level a host can keep a game to. Mirrors public.difficulty. A room or game without one (null) uses every category: Any.

GameStatus.description: A recorded game: in_progress until it ends as finished (Final revealed) or abandoned (room closed or everyone left).

Verdict.description: correct/incorrect from the judge; overridden when the host changes a verdict; appeal_pending while the worker's appeal judge decides.

RoomCode.description: Short code players type to join a room.
